description: This PHP source file defines the API endpoint class 'BuzzLikeOnCommentAPI' for managing likes on comments within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It includes methods for listing likes, liking, and unliking comments, with associated validation rules, transaction management, and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentAPI
classes.description: API controller class for managing likes on comments, supporting listing, creating, and deleting likes.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of likes on a specific comment identified by commentId, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Adds a like to a comment by the authenticated user, updating the like count and storing the like record.

methods.name: setBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Helper method to set the properties of a BuzzLikeOnComment entity based on request parameters and current user.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a like by the authenticated user from the specified comment, updating the like count.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getAll' method query parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'create' method request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'delete' method request parameters.
